mappings.name: can-edit

originalInput.name: can-edit
originalInput.covers: canEdit() is the doc.pages.assemble authority, wildcard included; it is the one twin for every structure verb.

mappings.retainedIntent: Assemble and download selectors are independent; wildcard grants both.

mappings.name: rotate-by

originalInput.name: rotate-by
originalInput.covers: rotateBy turns a relative turn into the absolute wire from the registry rotation, wrapping into [0, 360); an unknown page rejects not-found; any number is carried through the arithmetic.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old arbitrary deltas 45/450/-720/-900/0.5/NaN retire outside current rotateBy 90|-90|180 contract. Retain quarter turns, negative wrapping, mixed initial rotations and unknown refs; direct tests add pending turns.
mappings.retainedIntent: Relative quarter/half turns use confirmed current rotations; unknown pages reject before staging.

mappings.name: rotate-by-follows-the-registry

originalInput.name: rotate-by-follows-the-registry
originalInput.covers: After a pages.rotated event replaces the registry, rotateBy starts from the new rotation.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.retainedIntent: A remote confirmed layout replaces the registry before the next relative turn.

mappings.name: passthroughs

originalInput.name: passthroughs
originalInput.covers: setRotation, move and delete forward their arguments unchanged and return the engine promise, which settles with the engine answer.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a document keeps at least one page

mappings.partialRetirement: Old move/raw index, empty passthrough and arbitrary engine public answers retire; reorder validates refs and stages pages.reorder, void returns, and confirmed registry changes preserve edit intent.
mappings.retainedIntent: Absolute rotation, reorder and delete stage precise current ops, then expose confirmed order/count.

mappings.name: refused-by-the-engine

originalInput.name: refused-by-the-engine
originalInput.covers: Without doc.pages.assemble canEdit() is false, and every verb still calls the engine, whose PermissionDenied rejects the returned promise with its full shape.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old no-local-gate requirement retires: all local verbs assert permissions before staging. Separate permitted document still witnesses engine Forbidden mapping; extract/duplicate download authority added.
mappings.retainedIntent: Local permission gates refuse all writes before engine work; an allowed verb preserves engine refusal.

mappings.name: deferred-and-aborted

originalInput.name: deferred-and-aborted
originalInput.covers: A deferred edit settles when the engine answers, and the verbs run one at a time: the delete reaches the engine only after the rotate settles.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old await-prior-response dispatch retires: current queue sends apply calls immediately in staging order, engine owns serialization. Each deferred response still controls promise and confirmed layout; direct extraction barrier/cancel tests retain timing intent.
mappings.retainedIntent: Deferred staged edits are sent in staging order; pages stay confirmed until each event arrives.

mappings.name: add-blank

originalInput.name: add-blank
originalInput.covers: insertBlank: append by default sized like the last page; ref placements land after/before the anchor sized like it; an index placement is forwarded verbatim and sized like its predecessor, clamped into the registry; explicit size and count win; a missing anchor rejects not-found.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old numeric/clamped/negative/out-of-range index placement and ambiguous index+after/after+before inputs retire under neighbour/start/end PagePosition. Retain append, empty options, before/after each anchor, explicit count3/2,size612x792/1x2, missing anchors through scenario plus six direct matrix rows.
mappings.retainedIntent: Blank defaults and explicit size/count use end/start or validated neighbour positions.

mappings.name: add-blank-fractional-index

originalInput.name: add-blank-fractional-index
originalInput.covers: An index placement that is not an integer (or NaN) makes the predecessor lookup read a page that does not exist, which throws the TypeError the TypeScript throws; an explicit size skips the lookup.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old fractional/NaN predecessor TypeErrors and explicit-size bypass retire; malformed numeric neighbour refs now reject exact not-found even with size. Original source preserved verbatim.
mappings.retainedIntent: Index positions retired; invalid numeric neighbour arguments now reject not-found without TypeErrors, explicit size does not bypass validation.

mappings.name: insert

originalInput.name: insert
originalInput.covers: insertFromBytes forwards the bytes and the resolved placement index; a missing anchor rejects not-found before any engine call.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Raw placement index7 retires to neighbour/end positions. Source bytes, empty bytes, default and missing-anchor refusal remain; public result now pages from ChangeResult.
mappings.retainedIntent: Byte insertion retains source bytes and validated neighbour/end position; missing anchors refuse.

mappings.name: a-captured-capability-outlives-its-document

originalInput.name: a-captured-capability-outlives-its-document
originalInput.covers: A capability captured before its document closed keeps its guarded handle and the last registry it saw: canEdit still answers, and each verb still reaches the engine, but its promise rejects instance-closed (the kernel no longer resolves the capability).
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old post-close page service calls retire: change queue rejects the document closed before engine call. Captured canEdit remains true, unresolved token absent, ref-based rotate/insert reject instance-closed.
mappings.retainedIntent: Captured capability reads authority after close; staged verbs reject instance-closed while unresolved token lookup is absent.

mappings.name: an-empty-registry

originalInput.name: an-empty-registry
originalInput.covers: A document with no pages: rotation reads as 0, a PON anchor is not found, and a blank page defaults to US Letter wherever it goes.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: page undefined is not in this document

mappings.partialRetirement: Old missing ref rotation=0 and raw/fractional index placements retire. Current missing refs reject before staging; Letter default and insertion into empty registry remain.
mappings.retainedIntent: Missing pages reject; an empty document inserts Letter blanks at start/end then exposes confirmed new pages.

mappings.name: rotate-by-groups-and-empty

originalInput.name: rotate-by-groups-and-empty
originalInput.covers: rotateBy groups pages by their resulting rotation and makes one engine call per group, in first-seen order, resolving with the last answer; no pages rejects invalid-input without an engine call.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old multiple independent service promises and last answer retire; all rotation groups now form one atomic apply/history entry and public rotation returns void. First-seen groups and empty refusal remain.
mappings.retainedIntent: Different rotations group as three ops in one history transaction; empty pages reject.

mappings.name: move-to-the-end

originalInput.name: move-to-the-end
originalInput.covers: move with 'end' (or no placement) sends the registry's page count as the destination; ref placements resolve after or before their anchor.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: move and omitted/raw index position retire to reorder with explicit end or validated neighbour positions. Order, end/ref placement and missing-anchor intent remain.
mappings.retainedIntent: Reorder keeps end and validated ref positions; missing anchor refuses.

mappings.name: insert-a-subset-of-another-pdf

originalInput.name: insert-a-subset-of-another-pdf
originalInput.covers: insertFromBytes with pageIndexes opens the bytes beside the document (full scope, an id from the clock), lists its pages, extracts the chosen ones by ref, inserts the extract at the placement and closes the source. A missing index rejects not-found and still closes the source; a refused open rejects with the mapped error.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Empty source indexes no longer extract/insert empty PDF: refsOf no-pages refusal before opening. Success [2,0] source order/full scope/id/extract/close, invalid source index close and open refusal remain.
mappings.retainedIntent: Scratch source opens with full scope, extracts selected refs in order and closes on success/refusal.

mappings.name: insert-a-subset-names-the-missing-index

originalInput.name: insert-a-subset-names-the-missing-index
originalInput.covers: The source id is Date.now() in base 36. A pageIndexes entry that is negative, fractional or not finite names no page and rejects not-found, the message spelling the index as String() does (1e+21, 1e-7 and all).
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the PDF has no page Infinity

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the PDF has no page NaN

mappings.retainedIntent: Source ids use the clock; invalid source indexes name their value in not-found and close the scratch handle.

mappings.name: rotate-by-a-page-without-a-rotation

originalInput.name: rotate-by-a-page-without-a-rotation
originalInput.covers: A registry page with no rotation turns into NaN, which is its own Map key: the numbered pages still group apart from it, one engine call per group.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Undefined rotation is outside mandatory typed PageLayout and malformed NaN grouping retires; current valid registry mixed-rotation grouping independently asserted. Original malformed input preserved in history.
mappings.retainedIntent: Malformed undefined rotations retire; valid mixed registry rotations retain separate groups.

mappings.name: insert-from-another-document

originalInput.name: insert-from-another-document
originalInput.covers: insertFromDocument extracts the pages from the other open document's handle and inserts the bytes at the placement ('end' by default); a document that is not open rejects not-found; a refused extract rejects with the mapped error.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old direct unvalidated refs retire; source registry resolves refs/indexes before extraction. Retain open source, default/explicit placement, absent source and refused source download; add missing source ref before extraction.
mappings.retainedIntent: Open source resolves its own refs/indexes and extracts bytes; missing source/page and source download refusal propagate.

mappings.name: duplicate

originalInput.name: duplicate
originalInput.covers: duplicate extracts the pages and inserts the copy right after the last of them by default, or at the placement given; no pages rejects invalid-input before any engine call.
originalInput.reason: page-edit dispatches no actions. These cases pin what each verb sends the engine and how its promise settles.

mappings.partialRetirement: Old placement/raw service return retires; current options.position, assemble+download authority, pending-settle barrier and staged duplicate label preserve copy/extract intent. Unknown/empty refusals stay exact.
mappings.retainedIntent: Duplicate waits for staged work then extracts and inserts after last ref; explicit end, unknown/empty refusals and direct extraction survive.

mappings.name: state-and-scope

originalInput.name: state-and-scope
originalInput.covers: The plugin keeps an empty slice per document and has no capability before a document opens.

mappings.partialRetirement: Empty document slice retires to selected refs state. Pre-open absence/authority remain; selection resolving/dedup/clear and deletion projection added as direct witnesses.
mappings.retainedIntent: Capability is absent before open; current selection is empty and selecting pages deduplicates resolved refs.
